sections.heading: Flagged items in detail
paragraphs: Current Ratio Liquidity: Current assets cover current liabilities 1.17 times. Liquidity is tight relative to short-term obligations.
Gross Margin Stability: Gross margin varied with a standard deviation of 4.4 percentage points. Margin volatility suggests commodity exposure or weak pricing power.
Operating Margin Stability: Operating margin standard deviation of 4.4 pp indicates cost swings that make forecasting unreliable.

Payout Ratio Sustainability: Dividends absorbed 113% of earnings against free cash flow of 75% of net profit. The payout is above what the business generates, so it depends on cash reserves or borrowing.
Earnings Volatility Check: Earnings per share fell in 2 of the last 4 years with a growth standard deviation of 38 points. Earnings are erratic, which argues for a wider margin of safety.
Book Value Compounding: Book value per share compounded -7.8% annually. Retained earnings are not translating into balance-sheet growth.

Auditor & Governance Cleanliness: Aggregating the accounting evidence: 2 hard red flags and 4 watch items, with a LojikX™ Consistency Score of 74/100. The pattern of flags warrants a closer read of the auditor notes and related-party disclosures.
